title: Say Less, Hallucinate Less? Diagnosing and Restoring Object Coverage in Preference-Optimized Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.23179v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Preference optimization (PO) is the standard way to reduce object hallucination in large vision-language models. We find that four public PO checkpoints of LLaVA-1.5-7B also lower object coverage. They name fewer object categories, and their lower hallucination rates bring no significant gain in set-level object F1 on CHAIR. We therefore ask how much of the PO gain the base model can reproduce by stopping earlier. A positive end-of-sequence (EOS) logit bias lets the base model reach the recall of each PO model, and this early stopping alone reproduces 58 to 86 percent of the CHAIRi gain of three checkpoints on two disjoint COCO sets. Writing longer does not bring the lost categories back. Under greedy decoding, a negative EOS bias recovers only 2 to 9 percent of the lost CHAIR recall of these checkpoints, and 94 to 96 percent of the added object mentions repeat categories already named. translated_title: 少说，就少幻觉吗？诊断与恢复偏好优化视觉语言模型中的物体覆盖率
translated_abstract: 偏好优化（PO）是降低大型视觉语言模型物体幻觉的标准方法。我们发现，LLaVA-1.5-7B 的四个公开 PO 检查点在降低幻觉的同时也降低了物体覆盖率。它们命名的物体类别更少，且其更低的幻觉率在 CHAIR 的集合级物体 F1 上并未带来显著提升。因此我们提出问题：基础模型通过更早停止输出能复现多少 PO 的收益。正的序列结束（EOS）logit 偏置可使基础模型达到每个 PO 模型的召回率，仅凭这种早停策略就能在两个不相交的 COCO 数据集上复现三个检查点 CHAIRi 收益的 58% 至 86%。写得更长并不能找回丢失的类别。在贪心解码下，负的 EOS 偏置仅能恢复这些检查点丢失的 CHAIR 召回率的 2% 至 9%，且新增的物体提及中有 94% 至 96% 是重复已命名的类别。在 CHAIR 上，同一图像的基础描述仍然……
tldr: 该研究发现偏好优化在降低视觉语言模型物体幻觉的同时会牺牲物体覆盖率，其收益主要源于“输出更少”，基础模型仅通过正 EOS 偏置早停即可复现 58%–86% 的幻觉降低效果。
